'''M-04-12''' was a medical file regarding the injuries and [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of several workers in a tunnel collapse in the [[Morjanssik Mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] following the malfunction of twenty [[Q-4 Borer Droid]]s. Four workers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] and three injured in the tunnel collapse.
